subject.title: fix(agents): treat codex exec_command as exec-like

question: Should maintainers keep requiring live Codex app-server proof for this `exec_command` warning fix, or explicitly accept the source-contract plus targeted OpenClaw tests as sufficient?
rationale: The code direction appears right, but repository policy requires dependency/Codex contract inspection and real behavior proof for user-visible warning delivery; overriding that proof gap is a maintainer judgment, not an automation decision.

options.title: Require live proof before merge
options.body: Ask for redacted Codex app-server terminal output, logs, copied live output, or a recording after a branch refresh before considering merge.

options.title: Accept source-contract proof
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly override the proof gate if Codex source plus focused event-to-warning tests are enough for this narrow path.

options.title: Pause or close the branch
options.body: If no live or producer-path evidence can be produced, maintainers can close this PR and leave the canonical issue open for a future proven fix.

recommendation.title: Require live proof before merge
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Codex app-server terminal output, logs, copied live output, or a recording after a branch refresh before considering merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently maintained the shared agent tool surfaces and already routed a narrower duplicate PR toward this broader candidate.
